items.name: utils
items.title: cn helper
items.description: cn() that understands Flow text styles and shadows. Replaces shadcn's lib/utils.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: urbanflow Button: primary / secondary / tertiary / plain × default / critical / success tones, micro / medium / large and icon sizes, loading and pressed states.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: urbanflow Icon Button and Icon Button Group: square icon-only actions (24 / 28 / 32px) and the floating toolbar cluster.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: urbanflow Badge: default / info / critical × label / number / small-number.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: urbanflow Checkbox: 16px box or eye (layer visibility), checked / indeterminate, optional inline label.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: urbanflow Toggle: 36×21 on/off switch (Radix Switch) with optional label.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: urbanflow Tooltip: dark label with a tail on hover or focus.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: urbanflow Field shell (label, help text, error / alert) and Inline Error, shared by Text Field, Multiline Field and Select.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: urbanflow Text Field: 32px input with label, unit, prefix / suffix icon, number stepper, help text, error / alert, disabled, read only, inline label.

items.name: multiline-field
items.title: Multiline Field
items.description: urbanflow Multiline Field: textarea with label, character count, help text and error / alert.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: urbanflow Select: 36px trigger with chevron opening an Action List of options; label default / inline / hidden.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: urbanflow Tabs: 28px pill tabs (Flow Tab) or dense underline tabs (Flow Underline Tab) via TabsList variant.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: urbanflow Segmented Control: 2–4 mutually exclusive options, text or icon.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: urbanflow Page Header: back, title with badge or leading mark, description, actions.

items.name: full-screen-modal-header
items.title: Full Screen Modal Header
items.description: urbanflow Full Screen Modal Header: 56px title bar with back, leading mark, tabs, actions and close.

items.name: action-list
items.title: Action List
items.description: urbanflow Action List: static ActionList / ActionSection / ActionItem, and DropdownMenu built on the same styles (icon, help text, destructive, selected, disabled).

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: urbanflow Modal over the Dimmer: grey title bar, body, right-aligned footer; default 620px or small 360px.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: urbanflow Toast: dark pill (or critical red) with optional action and dismiss; auto-dismisses after 4s.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: urbanflow Banner: info / success / warning / critical, as a card with a tinted icon tile or inCard on a tinted ground; title, description, actions, dismiss.

items.name: color-indicator
items.title: Color Indicator
items.description: urbanflow Color Indicator: 14px (or 8px small) swatch keying a series, zone or category to a Misc colour.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: urbanflow Avatar (L 28 · M 24 · S 20 · XS 18, initials on a Misc colour or a photo) and Avatars Stacked (+N after max).

items.name: chip-filter
items.title: Chip Filter
items.description: urbanflow Chip Filter: pill toggle for filtering a list; selected inverts.

items.name: dropdown-pill
items.title: Dropdown Pill
items.description: urbanflow Dropdown Pill: compact pill that opens a menu to set a category inline; empty reads Unclassified.

items.name: scroll-indicator
items.title: Scroll Indicator
items.description: urbanflow Scroll Indicator (5px light or dark thumb) and ScrollArea that uses it.

items.name: thumbnail
items.title: Thumbnail
items.description: ↪ Urbanflow Thumbnail: render, plan or file tile (xsmall 24 · small 40 · medium 60 · large 80) with a placeholder glyph.

items.name: hybrid-button-group
items.title: Hybrid Button Group
items.description: ↪ Urbanflow Hybrid Button Group: floating canvas bar with the current mode, its object and one action.

items.name: building-select
items.title: Building Select
items.description: ↪ Urbanflow Building Select (24px building / floor / zone tree row with connectors, caret, count, add and more) and Building Header.

items.name: output-select
items.title: Output Select
items.description: ↪ Urbanflow Output Select: selectable analysis-run card with thumbnail, meta, badges and key metrics.

items.name: template-select
items.title: Template Select
items.description: ↪ Urbanflow Template Select: 116px floor-plate template tile.

items.name: policy
items.title: Policy
items.description: ↪ Compliance Policy: collapsible rule reference with source link and quoted clause.

items.name: compliance-issue
items.title: Compliance Issue
items.description: ↪ Compliance Issue: result card with a 2px pass/fail rail; opens to a Required / Actual table, a Policy and a Dismiss footer.

items.name: photo
items.title: Photo
items.description: ↪ Comments Photo: image attachment tile (S 60px or L 120×90), selected ring, +N overflow, optional remove.

items.name: comment-pin
items.title: Comment Pin
items.description: ↪ Comments Comment Pin: 32px canvas pin; read, unread, selected, resolved, typing; stacked avatars or a group count.

items.name: comment-thread
items.title: Comment Thread
items.description: ↪ Comments Comment Thread: panel row with location, author, time, first message and replies; unread dot; more and resolve on hover.

items.name: comment-section
items.title: Comment Section
items.description: ↪ Comments Comment Section (panel header with filter menu and close) and Comment Search (search field with empty-state guidance or no-match message).

items.name: view-comment
items.title: View Comment
items.description: ↪ Comments View Comment: open thread popover beside its pin — header actions, messages with photos and a reply composer.
